notes: The continuation proposes a tame topological setting for intuition of shape and form, mentioning homotopy types of spaces of homeomorphisms and imbeddings and a comprehensive dévissage theory of stratified structures.

The other continent is described as a confluence of topology, conformal and algebraic geometry, discrete and profinite groups, algebraic groups over number fields, regular polyhedra, arithmetics and motives, for studying absolute Galois actions on anabelian profinite geometrical fundamental groups. The two inline examples are retained literally.
The separate incomplete sentence begins One of the leading threads and ends combinatorial topology. The following standalone direction reads (Continues without change until last paragraph).

The last paragraph says the two first volumes of Pursuing Stacks were started through English correspondence and are in English; a first part of their common introduction, personal rather than technical, is in French, called the author's adopted language. The visible revised word order two first is retained.
No title heading, date, author page number or total page count is written here. The lower-left archive number is 10 and is recorded only as a comment.
